criteria.requirement: Extend actual natural_list(items,*,conjunction=None,serial_comma=False,localized=False) preserving byte-for-byte default English output. Consume/stringify a one-shot iterable once, correctly handle 0/1/2/many items. localized=True uses the existing real translated "%s and %s" catalog pattern; custom literal nonempty conjunction overrides it without percent-string interpretation. serial_comma is explicit for 3+ items only, with strict boolean options and Unicode/empty-string item preservation. Do not split translations/commas/connection words into separate objectives or change current activated language automatically.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
